automation_name: << Pipedrive Workflow Automations CANNOT be listed via the API — all of /v1/automations, /v2/automations, /v1/workflows, /v1/workflowAutomations, /v1/automations/list, /v1/legacyAutomations return 404. Export them from Pipedrive -> Tools and apps -> Workflow automations (filter: ALL automations, include inactive), then fill one row per automation here. >>
